document.about: LAPP innovation catalogue, spring 2026 (36 pages). Its product pages share one template: box headings and the close of a standard description stand at the same place on page after page, and a thumb index runs down the side margin.

notes: The template's repeated text was taken for watermarks and deleted. The side-margin thumb index is page furniture and is still removed.

checks.issue: Technical data, a box heading on every product page, survived on 5 of 25.
The last line of a repeated sentence, gland., was deleted, and the sentence ran into what followed.
